recipes.name: Greek Lemon-Oregano Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.subtitle: With village salad (horiatiki) and tzatziki
recipes.ing: 2¼ lb chicken breast · 1 Tbsp olive oil · Zest of 1 lemon · 4 cloves garlic · 2 tsp dried oregano · 1¼ tsp kosher salt · ½ tsp black pepper · 2½ lb yellow potatoes · 1½ Tbsp olive oil · 1 tsp dried oregano · 1 tsp kosher salt · ½ tsp black pepper · 2 lemons (juice ~4–5 Tbsp total) · 1 can chickpeas · 1 tsp olive oil · ½ tsp smoked paprika · ¼ tsp kosher salt · 1½ cups Greek yogurt · ½ English cucumber · 2 cloves garlic · 1 tsp dried dill · 1 tsp olive oil · ½ tsp kosher salt · 2 English cucumbers · 9 oz grape tomatoes · ½ red onion · 1 green bell pepper · ⅓ cup kalamata olives · 6 oz feta · 2 Tbsp olive oil · 2 Tbsp red wine vinegar · 1 tsp dried oregano · ¼ tsp kosher salt
recipes.notes: Zest goes on before roasting and juice after, because juice blocks browning. Lunch salads stay undressed.

recipes.name: Maple-Gochujang Chicken
recipes.subtitle: Roasted sweet potato, air-fried broccoli, spicy cucumber salad (oi-muchim)
recipes.ing: 2¼ lb chicken breast · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · 1 tsp kosher salt · ½ tsp black pepper · 2½ lb sweet potatoes · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · ¾ tsp kosher salt · 1½ lb broccoli florets · 2 tsp neutral oil · ¼ tsp kosher salt · ¼ cup gochujang paste · 3 Tbsp maple syrup · 2 Tbsp soy sauce · 1 Tbsp rice vinegar · 1 tsp gochugaru · 3 cloves garlic · 1 tsp ginger, grated · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 3 Tbsp water · 2 scallions · 1 Tbsp sesame seeds · 1 English cucumber · ½ tsp kosher salt · 1–2 tsp gochugaru · 1 clove garlic · 1 scallion · 2 tsp rice vinegar · 1 tsp sugar · ½ tsp fish sauce · ½ tsp sesame oil · ½ tsp sesame seeds
recipes.notes: The glaze is reduced on the stove and tossed on at the end; maple syrup scorches if it's baked on at 425°F. The cucumber salad is for dinner only.

recipes.name: Pork & Edamame Fried Rice
recipes.subtitle: Uses the banked pork shoulder and freezer vegetables
recipes.ing: 3 cups cold cooked jasmine rice · 1 small bag pork shoulder, thawed (10–16 oz) · 3 eggs (4 if pork is under 12 oz) + pinch salt · 1½ cups frozen shelled edamame · 1 bag frozen stir-fry vegetables (12–16 oz) · 4 scallions · 4 cloves garlic · 1 Tbsp ginger, grated from frozen · 2 Tbsp soy sauce · 1 Tbsp oyster sauce · ½ tsp sugar · ½ tsp white or black pepper · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 1 Tbsp neutral oil
recipes.notes: Stir-fries move too fast to prep mid-cook, so everything is staged before the pan heats.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
recipes.subtitle: With yogurt crema, cheddar, scallions and lime
recipes.ing: 2 tsp olive oil · 1 yellow onion · 1 bell pepper · 3 cloves garlic · 1.7 lb ground turkey 93/7 (one package) · ¼ cup mild chili powder · 2 tsp ground cumin · 1 tsp dried oregano · 1½ Tbsp tomato paste · Salt to taste at the end · 1 × 28 oz can diced tomatoes · 1 cup broth (bouillon + water) · 2 × 15 oz cans kidney beans · 1½ cups frozen corn · 5 oz shredded sharp cheddar · ½ cup Greek yogurt + 1½ tsp lime juice + pinch salt · 1 lime · 2 scallions · Tortilla chips
recipes.notes: One 1.7 lb package of turkey per batch makes a meaty chili. No cayenne in the pot, so it stays mild; add hot sauce at the table. Bouillon is salty, so salt goes in at the end.

recipes.name: Japanese Chicken Curry
recipes.subtitle: Chicken, potato, carrot and peas in curry-roux sauce, over rice
recipes.ing: 2 cups short-grain or calrose rice · 2½ cups water · 2½ lb chicken breast · 1 tsp kosher salt · 2 large yellow onions · 1 lb baby carrots · 1½ lb baby potatoes · 3 cloves garlic · 1 tsp fresh ginger, grated · 2 cups frozen peas · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · 3 cups water · 3½–4 oz Japanese curry roux blocks (about 1¼ boxes of 3.2 oz S&B) · 1 Tbsp ketchup · 1 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce · 1 tsp honey
recipes.notes: Japanese home-style curry (kare) built on store roux blocks, which is how it's made in most Japanese homes. The roux never goes in under pressure: it scorches and triggers a burn notice. Onions cooked to golden give the sauce its sweetness. Peas aren't in every version; they're here as the green vegetable.

recipes.name: Seared Sirloin with Roasted Potatoes & Broccoli
recipes.subtitle: One sheet pan of potatoes and broccoli, steak in a skillet
recipes.ing: 1¼ lb top sirloin, one 1¼-inch-thick steak · 1 tsp kosher salt · ½ tsp black pepper · 1 tsp neutral oil · 1½ lb baby potatoes · 1 Tbsp olive oil · ¾ tsp kosher salt · ¼ tsp black pepper · 1 tsp garlic powder · 1 lb broccoli florets · 2 tsp olive oil · ¼ tsp kosher salt
recipes.notes: The broccoli joins the potatoes partway through so both finish together on one pan. Pull the steak at 125–130°F for medium-rare; it rises a few degrees while it rests. USDA's minimum for steak is 145°F with a 3-minute rest.

recipes.name: Beef Deshebrada Sopes
recipes.subtitle: Guajillo-braised shredded chuck on masa sopes, with refried pintos and calabacitas
recipes.ing: 8 dried California chiles · 3 dried ancho chiles · 3 Roma tomatoes · ½ white onion · 5 cloves garlic · 1 cup beef or chicken broth · 1½ Tbsp apple cider vinegar · ½ tsp ground cumin · 1 tsp Mexican oregano · 2 whole cloves (optional) · Pinch of cayenne or 1 chipotle (optional, for more heat) · 3 lb beef chuck roast · 2 tsp kosher salt · 2 bay leaves · 5 cups masa harina · 2 tsp kosher salt · 4½ cups warm water · 2 Tbsp neutral oil · 3 × 15 oz cans pinto beans · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · ½ white onion, diced · 2 cloves garlic · ¾ cup water · ½ tsp kosher salt · 1 Tbsp olive oil · ½ white onion, diced · 2 cloves garlic · 3 medium zucchini · 2 Roma tomatoes · 2 cups frozen corn · ½ tsp Mexican oregano · ½ tsp kosher salt · 1 romaine heart, shredded · ½ white onion, finely diced · 1 bunch radishes, thinly sliced · 10 oz queso fresco, crumbled · 1 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt + 2 Tbsp lime juice + pinch salt · 4 limes
recipes.notes: Carne deshebrada is stewed in a dried red chile sauce, here California and ancho chiles, then shredded and cooked down until the sauce clings. The chuck isn't seared first; that's typical for this dish. Sopes are thick masa cakes with a pinched rim, griddled and then crisped. They're traditionally fried in lard; here they get a light brush of oil on a dry skillet instead, which is less rich and a

recipes.name: Gochujang Turkey & Sweet Potato Bowls
recipes.subtitle: Glazed ground turkey with edamame, roasted sweet potato and green beans, quick cucumber pickle
recipes.ing: 2½ lb sweet potatoes · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · ¾ tsp kosher salt · 1 lb trimmed green beans · 2 tsp neutral oil · ¼ tsp kosher salt · 2 English cucumbers · ¼ cup rice vinegar · 1 tsp sugar · ½ tsp kosher salt · ¼ cup gochujang paste · 3 Tbsp soy sauce · 2 Tbsp honey · 1 Tbsp rice vinegar · 2 tsp toasted sesame oil · ¼ cup water · 2 lb ground turkey 93/7 · 1 tsp neutral oil · 4 cloves garlic · 1 Tbsp fresh ginger, grated · 4 scallions, whites and greens separated · 1½ cups frozen shelled edamame · 1 Tbsp sesame seeds
recipes.notes: A Korean-American fusion bowl, not a traditional Korean dish. The glaze reduces in the turkey skillet, so there's no separate saucepan. Brown the turkey hard before the glaze goes in; steamed grey turkey won't take on the sauce.

recipes.name: Skillet Apple Crisp
recipes.subtitle: Apples cooked down first with reduced cider, under a pecan-oat topping
recipes.ing: ¾ cup all-purpose flour · ¾ cup pecans, finely chopped · ¾ cup old-fashioned rolled oats · ½ cup packed light brown sugar · ¼ cup granulated sugar · ½ tsp ground cinnamon · ½ tsp salt · 8 Tbsp unsalted butter, melted · 3 lb Golden Delicious or Honeycrisp apples (6–7 large) · ¼ cup granulated sugar · ¼ tsp ground cinnamon · 1 cup apple cider · 2 tsp lemon juice · 2 Tbsp unsalted butter · Vanilla ice cream
recipes.notes: Most crisps bake raw apples under the topping, and the apples shed juice that sogs the topping before they soften. Cooking the apples on the stove first drives off that water and cooks them evenly, and the reduced cider adds concentrated apple flavor. A short, very hot bake then just crisps the topping and finishes the fruit. Use apples that hold their shape: Golden Delicious, Honeycrisp or Braebu

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken
recipes.subtitle: Bottled teriyaki glaze, with sesame cabbage slaw, edamame and rice
recipes.ing: 1 cup jasmine or short-grain rice · 1¾ lb boneless skinless chicken breast · 1½ Tbsp cornstarch · 2 Tbsp neutral oil · ⅔ cup thick bottled teriyaki sauce (glaze style) · 14 oz bag coleslaw mix (plain shredded cabbage) · 2 Tbsp rice vinegar · 2 tsp toasted sesame oil · 2 tsp sugar · 1 tsp soy sauce · 1 Tbsp sesame seeds · 2 cups frozen shelled edamame · Pinch salt · 2 scallions
recipes.notes: Use a thick glaze-style sauce, not a thin marinade: a thin one runs off the chicken and tastes mostly of salt. Bottled glazes are thickened with sugar, so they glaze in a minute or two and scorch soon after. Turn the heat down before the sauce goes in. The cornstarch dusting browns the chicken and helps the sauce cling.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dal with Sweet Potato & Spinach
recipes.subtitle: Instant Pot masoor dal finished with a sizzling cumin-garlic tadka, with Greek-yogurt flatbreads and cumin yogurt
recipes.ing: 1¼ cups bread or all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling · 2 tsp baking powder · ½ tsp salt · 1¼ cups plain nonfat Greek yogurt · 2 tsp olive oil · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · 1 tsp cumin seeds · 1 yellow onion · 4 cloves garlic · 1 Tbsp grated fresh ginger · 1 tsp ground turmeric · 1 tsp ground coriander · 1 lb red lentils (about 2¼ cups) · 2 medium sweet potatoes · 4½ cups water · 1¼ tsp kosher salt · 1 × 14.5 oz can diced tomatoes · 5 oz baby spinach · 2 Tbsp lemon juice · ½ tsp garam masala · 1½ Tbsp ghee or butter · ½ tsp black mustard seeds (optional) · 1 tsp cumin seeds · 2 cloves garlic · 2 dried red chiles or ½ tsp red pepper flakes · ½ tsp Kashmiri chili powder or paprika · 2 cups plain nonfat Greek yogurt · ½ tsp ground cumin · ¼ tsp salt
recipes.notes: The tadka at the end is what makes dal taste like a restaurant's: whole spices and garlic fried in ghee and poured over at the last second, while they're still sizzling. Mustard seeds should pop before the cumin goes in. Pour the tomatoes on top and don't stir them in before pressure cooking: tomatoes on the bottom scorch and set off the burn warning. Dal thickens as it sits, so loosen leftovers w

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.subtitle: Velveted sirloin in oyster sauce, with lots of broccoli over rice
recipes.ing: 1 cup jasmine rice · 1¾ lb top sirloin · 2 Tbsp water · 1 tsp oyster sauce · 1 tsp cornstarch · ¼ tsp baking soda · 1½ lb broccoli florets · ⅓ cup water · ⅓ cup oyster sauce · ¼ cup water · 1½ Tbsp brown sugar · 1½ tsp cornstarch · 1½ tsp toasted sesame oil · 4 cloves garlic · 1 Tbsp grated fresh ginger · 2 Tbsp + 1 tsp neutral oil · 2 scallions (optional)
recipes.notes: The baking soda is the Chinese restaurant trick (velveting): it raises the pH at the meat's surface so the beef stays tender instead of tightening up in a hot pan. Keep the marinade to a light coating; a wet marinade pools and the beef boils instead of searing. Sear in two batches in a very hot pan for the same reason. Oyster sauce brands vary a lot in saltiness, so taste the sauce before it goes

recipes.name: Shawarma-Spiced Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.subtitle: Sheet-pan chicken, baby potatoes and carrots, with garlic yogurt and cucumber-tomato salad
recipes.ing: 2 tsp ground cumin · 2 tsp paprika · 1 tsp ground coriander · 1 tsp garlic powder · ½ tsp ground turmeric · ½ tsp ground cinnamon · ½ tsp black pepper · Pinch cayenne (optional) · 2½ lb baby potatoes · 1 lb baby carrots · 1 Tbsp + 2 tsp olive oil · 1 tsp kosher salt · 1¾ lb boneless skinless chicken breast · 1 Tbsp olive oil · 1¼ tsp kosher salt · Zest of 1 lemon · 1 cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt · 1 small clove garlic · 1 Tbsp lemon juice · ¼ tsp salt · 1–2 Tbsp water · 1 English cucumber · 10 oz grape tomatoes · 1 Tbsp lemon juice · 2 tsp olive oil · ¼ tsp salt · 2 lemons total (zest, juice and wedges)
recipes.notes: Shawarma-spiced, not shawarma: there's no spit, so the char comes from a hot pan and an optional 2-minute broil. Breast chunks dry out fast, so pull them at 160°F; they coast to 165°F while you plate. The carrots get crowded once the chicken goes on, which is fine since they're nearly done by then.

recipes.name: Creamy Chipotle Broth Bowls
recipes.subtitle: Honey-garlic beef, roasted zucchini and corn, black beans and rice in a creamy chipotle broth
recipes.ing: 30 oz zucchini (about 4 medium-large) · 1 Tbsp + 1 tsp olive oil · ½ tsp kosher salt · ¼ tsp black pepper · 2½ cups frozen corn · 1 tsp olive oil · ¼ tsp kosher salt · 20 oz ground beef 93/7 · 2½ Tbsp honey · 2½ Tbsp rice vinegar · 4 cloves garlic · 1¼ tsp kosher salt · 1¼ tsp ground cumin · ¼ tsp ground cinnamon · 3¾ cups beef bone broth · 1¼ cups low-fat cottage cheese · 2 chipotle peppers in adobo, plus 2 Tbsp adobo sauce · 2½ Tbsp double-concentrated tomato paste · 1 tsp smoked paprika · 1 can black beans (15 oz), drained and rinsed · Kosher salt to taste · 2½ cups cooked jasmine rice (frozen steamed rice) · 2 limes · Honey for drizzling (optional)
recipes.notes: A fitness-style brothy rice bowl, not a traditional Mexican dish: the beef is honey-garlic with cumin and cinnamon, and the broth gets its body from blended cottage cheese. The chipotle is set mild to medium; taste the hot broth and add more then. Keep the broth below a boil, first night and reheating, or the cottage cheese can turn grainy.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Chili Crisp Chicken & Rice
recipes.subtitle: Shredded chili crisp chicken with cabbage, carrots and edamame, spicy yogurt mayo and smashed cucumbers
recipes.time: 3½–4½ hr on high (or 4½–5½ on low), ~25 min hands-on
recipes.ing: 30 oz boneless skinless chicken breast · 4½ Tbsp chili crisp, divided (Lao Gan Ma or similar) · 2½ Tbsp honey · 2½ Tbsp soy sauce · 1 Tbsp + 1 tsp sriracha · 1 Tbsp fresh ginger, grated · 1 tsp garlic powder · ½ tsp white pepper · 1 bag coleslaw mix (14 oz) · 1½ cups matchstick carrots · 1½ cups frozen shelled edamame · 1 Tbsp + 1 tsp seasoned rice vinegar · 4 scallions · 1 Tbsp sesame seeds · 1¼ cups short-grain or sushi rice · 1½ cups chicken bone broth · 6 Tbsp nonfat Greek yogurt · 2 Tbsp light mayonnaise · 2½ Tbsp sriracha · 1 Tbsp ketchup · ¼ tsp garlic powder · Pinch of salt · Splash of milk · 2 English cucumbers · ½ tsp kosher salt · 1 Tbsp rice vinegar · 1 tsp sugar · 1 tsp soy sauce · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 1 clove garlic, grated
recipes.notes: An egg-roll-in-a-bowl take on a slow cooker meal-prep recipe: chili crisp chicken with cabbage, carrots and edamame stirred in at the end. The chicken throws a lot of liquid, and so does the cabbage, so most of the cooking liquid comes out before the vegetables go in and goes back only as needed. A tablespoon of chili crisp is held back for the end so some of it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Spicy Peanut Chicken Noodles
recipes.subtitle: Seared garlic chicken and whole wheat noodles in a honey-lime peanut sauce, with broccoli and edamame
recipes.ing: 20 oz chicken breast · 2 Tbsp soy sauce · 1½ Tbsp sriracha · ½ tsp garlic powder · ½ tsp onion powder · ¼ tsp red pepper flakes · ¼ tsp kosher salt · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · 10 cloves garlic · 5 scallions, whites and greens separated · 6 Tbsp creamy peanut butter (100 g) · 2 Tbsp + 1 tsp soy sauce · 1 Tbsp sriracha · 3½ Tbsp honey · 1½ limes, juiced · 10½ oz whole wheat linguine (300 g) · 1½ lb broccoli florets · 1½ cups frozen shelled edamame · 1 Tbsp kosher salt, for the pasta water
recipes.notes: An American-style peanut noodle, not a traditional Thai or Chinese dish. The lime goes into the sauce rather than the chicken marinade, so the chicken sears instead of steaming. The broccoli and edamame cook in the pasta pot for the last few minutes, so there's no third pan. The sauce tightens as it cools; loosen leftovers with a splash of water.

recipes.name: Quick Yogurt Naan
recipes.subtitle: Skillet naan from a Greek-yogurt dough, brushed with garlic butter
recipes.ing: 1½ cups bread or all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling · 2 tsp baking powder · ½ tsp kosher salt · 1¼ cups plain nonfat Greek yogurt · 2 tsp olive oil · 1 Tbsp butter or ghee · 1 clove garlic · Flaky salt (optional)
recipes.notes: Restaurant naan is a yeasted dough slapped onto the wall of a tandoor. This is the quick skillet version: baking powder and yogurt do the rising, so there's no proofing time. It's softer and less chewy than tandoor naan, but it blisters and puffs the same way if the pan is hot enough. The dough starts sticky, so flour your hands and the counter; the 15-minute rest relaxes the gluten so it rolls th

recipes.name: Japanese Ground-Meat Curry (Kīma Karē)
recipes.subtitle: Turkey and beef curry with carrots, potatoes and peas, thickened with curry roux, over calrose rice
recipes.ing: 1 cup calrose rice · 2 onions · 1 lb baby carrots · 1 lb potatoes · 1½ cups frozen peas · 4 cloves garlic · 1 Tbsp grated fresh ginger · 1.7 lb ground turkey · 1 lb ground beef, 93/7 · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · ½ tsp kosher salt · 2½ cups water · About 4 oz Japanese curry roux (about half a 7–8 oz box) · 1 Tbsp ketchup · 1 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce
recipes.notes: Kīma karē is the ground-meat style of Japanese home curry: thicker and less soupy than the stew version, with the meat spread through every bite. Turkey and beef together give a fuller flavor than turkey alone, much like the beef-pork mix used in Japan. Curry roux blocks set the sauce, so measure by the box: use the roux your box calls for with 2½ cups of water, which is about half of a standard 7

recipes.name: Gouda Chickpea Pasta with Chicken
recipes.subtitle: Chickpea pasta in a gouda and Jack cheese sauce with seared chicken, with a salad kit on the side
recipes.ing: 10 oz chickpea pasta · 1 Tbsp kosher salt, for the water · 1¼ lb chicken tenderloins · ½ tsp kosher salt · ¼ tsp black pepper · 1 Tbsp olive oil · 1 × 12 oz can fat-free evaporated milk · 1 Tbsp cornstarch · 3 cloves garlic · 1 tsp Dijon mustard · ¼ tsp black pepper · 2 oz Colby Jack or Monterey Jack · 2 oz aged gouda · 1 oz aged gouda · 2 salad kits (about 12 oz each)
recipes.notes: An aged gouda tastes great but doesn't melt smoothly on its own: past a few months it loses moisture, and in a hot sauce the fat separates and turns grainy. So the sauce is built on evaporated milk thickened with cornstarch, which keeps cheese emulsified, with Colby Jack doing most of the melting and part of the gouda for flavor. The rest of the gouda is grated over the top at the end. Add cheese

recipes.name: Creamy Gochujang Noodles with Crispy Beef
recipes.subtitle: Chewy noodles in a blended cottage cheese–gochujang sauce, topped with maple-glazed lean beef, with broccoli and edamame
recipes.ing: 1¼ cups low-fat cottage cheese · 5 Tbsp gochujang (105 g) · 5 Tbsp water · 1½ lb 96% lean ground beef · 1 tsp neutral oil · 2½ Tbsp maple syrup · 1½ Tbsp low-sodium soy sauce · 1 Tbsp rice vinegar · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 2 cloves garlic · 5 scallions, whites and greens separated · 12½ oz dried wheat noodles (knife-cut, lo mein or udon; 360 g) · 1 lb broccoli florets · 1 cup frozen shelled edamame · 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds
recipes.notes: The cottage cheese blends into a smooth, creamy, high-protein sauce. Toss it with the noodles off the heat: boiled, it can turn grainy. The noodle water stays unsalted because the gochujang and glaze carry plenty of salt. Let the beef sit undisturbed once the glaze goes in so it caramelizes into crispy bits.

recipes.name: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken Noodles
recipes.subtitle: Crispy ground chicken in a sticky honey, garlic, chili and black vinegar glaze, tossed with noodles and seared cabbage slaw
recipes.ing: 5 Tbsp honey · 3 Tbsp chili garlic sauce (or sriracha) · 3 Tbsp low-sodium soy sauce · 3 Tbsp Chinese black vinegar (or balsamic) · 1 Tbsp grated fresh ginger · 6 cloves garlic · ⅓ cup water · 1 × 14 oz bag coleslaw mix (about 8 cups) · 3 tsp olive oil, divided · 2 lb ground chicken breast · 5 scallions, greens sliced · 12 oz dried wheat noodles (knife-cut, lo mein or udon; 340 g) · 1 tsp toasted sesame oil · 1 Tbsp toasted sesame seeds
recipes.notes: Sear the slaw in two batches so it browns instead of steaming. Leave the chicken alone at first so it forms a golden crust, and stir sparingly once the sauce goes in so it reduces to a sticky glaze. Chinese black vinegar gives a malty, smoky tang. Balsamic works but tastes sweeter and fruitier.

recipes.name: Thai-Style Basil Chicken
recipes.subtitle: Chopped chicken with garlic, chilies and sweet basil, rice and stir-fried green beans
recipes.ing: 2½ cups calrose rice, dry · 30 oz chicken breast or tenderloins · 1 Tbsp neutral oil (for searing) · 3 Tbsp oyster sauce · 1 Tbsp soy sauce · 1 Tbsp fish sauce · 1 Tbsp brown sugar · 2 Tbsp water · 8 cloves garlic · 4 serrano peppers (2 for milder) · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · 2 cups sweet basil leaves (about 3 × 0.75 oz clamshells) · 1½ lb fresh green beans · 1 Tbsp neutral oil · 3 Tbsp water · 1 tsp soy sauce · Pinch of salt · Fried eggs, 1 per plate
recipes.notes: Modeled on pad krapow, made with sweet basil because holy basil isn't available here. Sweet basil is milder and sweeter, so this tastes like basil chicken rather than the peppery Thai original. Hand-chopping the chicken small, instead of slicing it, gives the dish its texture. Sear the chicken in two batches so it browns instead of stewing, and keep the heat high once the sauce goes in so it cooks

recipes.name: Turkey, White Bean & Kale Soup
recipes.subtitle: Instant Pot soup with ground turkey, cannellini, kale and lemon, with crusty bread
recipes.ing: 1.7 lb ground turkey · 1 Tbsp olive oil · 1 yellow onion · 2 carrots · 3 ribs celery · 6 cloves garlic · 2 tsp Italian seasoning (or dried thyme) · ¼–½ tsp red pepper flakes · 1¼ tsp kosher salt · ½ tsp black pepper · 4 cups chicken bone broth · 1 can diced tomatoes (14.5 oz) · 3 cans cannellini beans (15 oz each), drained and rinsed · 10 oz chopped kale · 1 lemon · ½ cup shredded parmesan · 5 slices crusty bread (about 1½ oz each)
recipes.notes: The kale goes in after pressure cooking so it stays green and holds some texture, and the lemon goes in off the heat so it stays bright. Scrape the pot bottom completely clean after adding the broth, or the Instant Pot can throw a burn warning.

recipes.name: Cottage Pie
recipes.subtitle: Beef and lentil filling with carrots and peas under a Yukon gold mash, with steamed broccoli
recipes.ing: 1½ lb ground beef 93/7 · ½ Tbsp olive oil · 1 yellow onion · 2 carrots · 4 cloves garlic · 2 Tbsp double-concentrated tomato paste · 2 Tbsp all-purpose flour · 2 cups beef bone broth · 2 Tbsp Worcestershire sauce · 1½ tsp dried thyme (or Italian seasoning) · ½ cup brown lentils, dry, rinsed · ½ tsp kosher salt · ½ tsp black pepper · 1½ cups frozen peas · 3 lb Yukon gold potatoes · 1 Tbsp kosher salt (for the water) · 2 Tbsp butter · ⅓ cup milk · ½ cup nonfat plain Greek yogurt · ½ tsp kosher salt · ¼ tsp black pepper · ¼ cup shredded parmesan · 2 bags steamable broccoli (12 oz each)
recipes.notes: A small amount of lentils cooks right in the gravy, adding fiber and stretching the beef without changing the dish. Tomato paste and Worcestershire give it depth, so no canned tomatoes are needed. Greek yogurt in the mash replaces most of the usual butter and cream; keep the 2 Tbsp butter for flavor.

recipes.name: Small-Batch Fudgy Brownies
recipes.subtitle: Half batch for the small square Pyrex glass dish (~5–5½ inch inside)
recipes.ing: 4 Tbsp butter (half a stick) · ½ cup granulated sugar · 1 large egg · ½ tsp vanilla extract · 3 Tbsp cocoa powder · ¼ cup all-purpose flour (spooned and leveled) · ⅛ tsp salt (pinch) · ⅛ tsp baking powder (pinch)
recipes.notes: 325°F instead of 350°F because glass holds heat and overbakes the edges. The dish size is estimated, not measured: if the inside bottom is closer to 6 inches, the brownies will be thinner, so start checking at 18–20 min.

recipes.name: Banana Cream Pie
recipes.subtitle: Blind-baked crust, stovetop vanilla pudding layered with bananas, whipped cream on top
recipes.ing: 1 pie crust, homemade or store-bought · 1 large egg · 1 Tbsp heavy cream · 2 large eggs, room temperature · 2 large egg yolks, room temperature · 1 cup granulated sugar (200 g) · 6 Tbsp cornstarch (48 g) · ¼ tsp salt · 3 cups whole milk · 1 Tbsp vanilla extract · ¼ cup unsalted butter, cold and cubed · 3 to 4 ripe bananas, divided · 2 cups heavy whipping cream · ¼ cup confectioners' sugar · 2 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.notes: A soupy banana cream pie almost always means undercooked pudding. Cornstarch needs to actually boil to thicken fully, and the egg yolks carry an enzyme that thins the filling back out unless it's cooked hot enough (about 205°F) to kill it. Cook it until the whisk leaves clear trails. Cold butter whisked in off the heat melts gradually and keeps the pudding glossy. Blind-baking the crust all the wa

recipes.name: Lemon Blueberry Cream Pie
recipes.subtitle: A favorite of many, including a very young Levi
recipes.ing: 1 cup sugar · 4 Tbsp cornstarch · 1 cup milk · 3 egg yolks, beaten · ¼ cup butter · 1 Tbsp grated lemon peel · ¼ cup lemon juice · 1 cup sour cream · 2 cups blueberries (fresh are better) · 1 pre-baked 8-inch pie crust · Whipped cream, if desired
recipes.notes: This pie is just the right texture with 4 Tbsp of cornstarch instead of 3 (discovered and revised 4/23). The lemon juice goes in after cooking because acid boiled with cornstarch weakens its thickening.
